subject: Packaging options walkthrough and tier mapping for Brightline pilot
messages:
From: Meera Shah <meera@brightlinetx.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@brightlinetx.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Options for pilot packaging + a couple clarifying Qs

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The execs liked the latency and the reranking examples, and we want to move to a small pilot focused on two use cases: triage summarization and clinician note embeddings. Procurement asked me to get clarity on packaging before we scope timelines. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you summarize which features are included at each tier (Compact / Core / Throughput) with a short note on which features are add-ons vs bundled? We want to avoid surprise charges.
2) We have an internal requirement that model quantization and KV-cache persistence be available for the pilot — is that in the Compact tier or only in higher tiers?

I've attached a short feature matrix and our internal MVP list (Brightline_MVP_feature_list.xlsx). Can you propose 2 feasible packaging options (one conservative, one aggressive) including estimated monthly run-rate and any onboarding credits or pilot discounts?

We'd like to get a mutual action plan to Procurement this week if possible — they want draft SOW + expected go-live window.

Best,
Meera
Meera Shah
Director, Clinical AI
Brightline Therapeutics

Attachments: Brightline_MVP_feature_list.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Meera Shah <meera@brightlinetx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Options for pilot packaging + a couple clarifying Qs

Thanks Meera — and thanks for the feature list, that helps a lot. Looping Ben (pricing/GT) and Karthik (product infra) and Lauren (CS/onboarding) so we can give a concise packaging proposal.

Quick answers up front:
- KV-cache persistence + basic quantization-friendly serving paths are available in Core and Throughput tiers by default. Compact supports low-cost quantized inference but persistent KV-cache (to preserve session state across calls) is a Core capability.
- Add-ons typically: dedicated SSO connectors, extended retention of prompt traces, and custom eval monitoring. Those are not part of Compact.

We will propose two options below. Numbers are ballpark monthly run-rate for the pilot (estimated steady-state; assume 3k monthly active clinicians, 12M tokens/month estimated, embeddings for notes ~250k vectors/month).

Option A — Conservative pilot (recommended for procurement)
- Tier: Core (reserved pilot pool 1 GPU cluster, autoscale min=1)
- Bundled: KV-cache persistence, quantization support, 30-day trace retention, per-route analytics dashboard
- Add-ons (optional): custom eval monitoring ($1,500/mo), SSO & SCIM ($500/mo)
- Estimated run-rate: $16,500/mo
- Pilot credit: 20% off first 3 months for pilots that sign SOW w/in 14 days

Option B — Aggressive (performance-first)
- Tier: Throughput (larger reserved pool + burst capacity)
- Bundled: all Core items + priority routing, extended 90-day traces, enhanced QA evals
- Add-ons: same as above optionally bundled at discount
- Estimated run-rate: $34,000/mo
- Pilot credit: 15% off first 6 weeks + dedicated onboarding support (1 PM, 2 eng days)

Open questions for Karthik: can we support the exact KV-cache durability model Meera needs (persist across restarts for session continuity)? If this would push them up to Throughput, flag that.

Next steps I propose: Ben to provide final pricing bullets + discounting approach; Lauren to draft the SOW skeleton and timeline; Karthik to confirm KV persistence guarantees. I can consolidate into an MAP doc and SOW draft for procurement.

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Lead — Account Sales
Redwood Inference

PRIYA / TEAM — quick pricing note and next actions.

1) KV persistence: Karthik confirms Core has session persistence but it’s best-effort across restarts; only Throughput supports SLA-backed 72-hour persistence window. Karthik, flag if that summary needs tightening.

2) Pilot credit terms: standard MAP pilot credit (20% off first 3 months) does not require a revenue commitment. We attach a short conversion window clause: if customer converts to a paid annual or committed Dedicated contract within 90 days of pilot end, we honor a one-time onboarding credit equal to the pilot credit applied. If they do not convert, no obligation. That wording tends to satisfy procurement while keeping us flexible.

3) Pricing bullets to include in MAP doc: Core pilot = $16,500/mo (as Priya listed) with 20% off for months 1–3; Throughput = $34k/mo with 15% off first 6 weeks and dedicated onboarding days. SSO/SCIM can be added in the first month at no charge for pilots that sign SOW within 14 days.

Next actions: Priya to consolidate MAP (I can draft the pricing table). Lauren to add onboarding milestones to SOW. Priya — I’ll prepare the DocuSign envelope once SOW draft is back; linking hubspot + DocuSign below.
